hero.title: Let's Create
hero.description: Whether you're building a brand, planning a campaign, documenting a milestone, or creating something entirely new—we'd love to hear your story.

form.label: Collaborate
form.title: Tell us about your project.
form.description: Every great collaboration begins with a conversation. Let us know what you have in mind, and we'll help shape it into something exceptional.

items.label: Location
items.value: Based in Chennai, India – Available Worldwide

items.question: How soon do you reply?
items.answer: We typically respond to all project enquiries within 24 to 48 hours with initial thoughts or scheduling links for a consultation.

items.question: What is your photography style?
items.answer: Our style combines documentary storytelling and artistic direction, focusing on genuine moments, natural light and authentic connections.

items.question: Do you travel for projects?
items.answer: Yes. We'll travel for projects across India and internationally depending on the scope and requirements.

items.question: Do you have a backup plan in case of an emergency?
items.answer: Absolutely. We maintain backup cameras, lenses, memory cards and production contingencies when required.

items.question: Do you offer engagement sessions?
items.answer: Yes. Engagement sessions are a great way to become comfortable in front of the camera before your wedding day.

items.question: Can you work with brands outside India?
items.answer: Yes. We can collaborate remotely with international brands and travel for production when required.

items.name: Review
items.answer: We review your project details, requirements, references and timeline.

items.name: Conversation
items.answer: We'll connect with you to understand the vision, goals and creative direction.

items.name: Understand
items.answer: We define the right creative approach, scope, deliverables and production requirements.

items.name: Proposal
items.answer: You'll receive a clear proposal covering the creative direction, scope, timeline and investment.

items.name: Create
items.answer: Once everything is aligned, we begin creating work that matters.

finalCta.title: Let's Create
finalCta.description: Tell us your story. We'll help bring it to life. Partner with us to create visual narratives that redefine your space.
